children: Wells Fargo's Consumer Banking and Lending revenue rose 5% year over year to $10.7 billion in 3Q, led by auto and credit card lending. Auto revenue jumped 33% on higher loan balances and wider spreads, with average auto loans up 31% to $58.8 billion. The bank added roughly 660,000 new credit card accounts in the quarter, and average credit card loans grew 5% to $53.9 billion. Home Lending revenue fell 15% on lower mortgage servicing income and declining loan balances, partially offsetting gains elsewhere in the consumer segment.
